content: La loŋweghathɨ weya Loi Nariye
Thavala thɨ loŋweghathɨ Jisas iye Krais, thiye Loi le ŋgaŋgaŋgi. Thoŋgo ra gharethovu weya ramanda tembe ra gharethovu weŋgiva oghaghandana olounda.
Kaero ra ghareghare thoŋgo ra gharethovu weya Loi na ra ghambugha le mbaro, tembe ra gharethovu weŋgiva le ŋgaŋga.
Thoŋgo emunjoru moli Loi ghagharethovu ina weinda, ne ra vakatha ŋgoreiya budakai i utugiya weinda na ra vakatha. Ma tembe i vuyowova weinda budakai i utuŋa na ra vakatha,
kaiwae Loi le ŋgaŋga ghinda valɨkaiwanda ra kivwala yambaneke. La rɨghe na valɨkaiwanda ra kivwala yambaneke kaiwae ra loŋweghathɨgha Jisas.
Thavala valɨkaiwanji thɨ kivwala yambaneke le vurɨgheghe? Mbe iyaeŋge vara thavala thɨ loŋweghathɨgha Jisas iye Loi Nariye.

Mbema Jisas Krais iya amalaghɨniye va i njama e yambane, i bapɨtaiso e mbwa, amba i mare na madɨbae i voru. Ma vambe i mena eŋge i bapɨtaiso e mbwa, ko va i mena i bapɨtaiso e mbwa na tembe i mareva na madɨbae i voru. Nyao Boboma i utuŋa iyako na utuko iyako emunjoru kaiwae amalaghɨniye rautu emunjoru moli.
Rautuutu Jisas kaiwae thegheto:
Nyao Boboma, le bapɨtaiso na le mare na madɨbae i voru. Theghetoke iyake lenji utuke i mboromboro.

Ghinda ra loŋweghathɨgha gharɨgharɨ thoŋgo thɨ utuŋa bigi regha utuniye, ko iyemaeŋge Loi le utuutu i kivwala gharɨgharɨ lenji utuutu, iya kaiwae mbala ra loŋweghathɨ. Na iye kaero i utuŋa Nariye utuniye.

Thela thoŋgo i loŋweghathɨgha Loi Nariye, kaero i ghareghare Loi le utuutuko iyako i emunjoru moli. Ko thela ma i loŋweghathɨgha Loi le utuutuko, iye kaero i wovakwanɨkwanɨŋa Loi kaiwae Loi le uturaŋgiya Nariye kaiwae ma i loŋweghathɨ.
Loi le uturaŋgiyako iyako ŋgoreiyake: Loi kaero i giya yawalɨ memeghabananiye weinda, na yawalɨko iyako rɨghe iye Nariye.
Thela i wovatha Loi Nariye, iye yawalɨke iyake kaero inawe; thela ma i wovatha Nariye, yawalɨke iyake ma inawe.
Utuutuke ghagovun
Ya roriya letake iyake e ghemi kaiwae nuwaŋguiya hu ghareghare thavala ghemi kaero hu loŋweghathɨgha Loi Nariye kaero hu wo yawalɨ memeghabananiye.
Weinda la gharematuwa ra mena weya Loi e naŋgo, kaiwae ra ghareghare emunjoru ne i wovatha la renuwaŋa thoŋgo thebigiya nuwandaiya ra naŋgowe na mbe ŋgoreiye vara amalaghɨniye le renuwaŋa.
Kaero ra ghareghare ma mbaŋa regha i goriwoyathuinda, mbaŋa ra naŋgowe ra ghareghare kaero i giya thebigiya ra naŋgowe.

Thoŋgo ghemi regha i thuweya ghaghae i vakatha tharɨ, tharɨko iya mane i vakatha na i meghaghathɨ moli weya Loi, mbala i naŋgo weya Loi tharɨko gharavakatha kaiwae na Loi i vamoru. Iyake ya utuutu thavala thɨ vakatha tharɨ na mane i vakatha na thɨ meghaghathɨ moli weya Loi. Emunjoru tharɨ vavana mbe inanjiwe, i vakatha lolo i meghaghathɨ moli weya Loi. Ma yaŋa i naŋgo tharɨ ŋgoranjiyako kaiwanji.
Vakathake raraitharɨ wolaghɨye idanji tharɨ. Ko iyemaeŋge tharɨ vavana mbe inanjiwe mane i vakatha lolo i meghaghathɨ moli weya Loi.
Ra ghareghare thela kaero i tabo na Loi nariye, mane i vakatha valaŋa tharɨ, kaiwae Loi Nariye i njimbukiki, na Seitan, iye tharɨ gharavakatha mane i vɨghathɨ.
Kaero ra ghareghare Loi le ŋgaŋga ghinda, na yambaneke laghɨye tharɨ gharavakatha Seitan i mbaroŋa.

Kaero ra ghareghare Loi Nariye va i mena e yambaneke na i giya ghareghare weinda, iya kaiwae ra ghareghareya Loi emunjoru moli. Ra tubwe weya Loi emunjoru moli na tembe ra tubwe weva Nariye Jisas Krais. Iye Loi emunjoru moli na yawalɨ memeghabananiye rɨghe.
Lo ŋgaŋga, thava hu kururu weŋgiya loi kwanɨkwan, hu botewoyathuŋgi.
